selection: Four stratified deep Anchors per epoch, preferentially including less culturally overlearned cases and at least one failed/delayed route per two epochs.
procedure: Freeze a decision cutoff before the decisive demonstration, validation or diffusion transition.
Create a pre-outcome packet containing only evidence that existed by the cutoff.
Remove names, exact dates, places, product names and other unnecessary identity cues where this does not destroy causal structure; store hidden mapping separately.

Ask the evaluated Agent to identify the dominant bottleneck, live candidate routes, cheapest discriminating test, required complements, main anti-law risk and whether to continue/defer/abandon each route.
Freeze the ResearchBet before outcome reveal.
Reveal post-cutoff validation/diffusion/failure evidence and write ResearchOutcome / prediction error.
Score causal/bottleneck/falsifier and direction predictions separately; do not score historical trivia recall.
Record suspected pretrained-memory leakage rather than silently treating it as research competence.
baselines: random serious-rival choice where candidate set is well defined
warning: Historical replay cannot fully blind a pretrained model to famous events. De-identification and less-famous holdouts reduce but do not eliminate leakage; prospective replay is therefore calibration evidence, not a clean causal estimate of historical researcher ability.
